name: Solve combinatorial counting and arrangement problems
description: Users asked for solutions to combinatorial problems involving counting arrangements, selections, and distributions of items, often with specific constraints such as distinct digits, limits on repetition, or guaranteed outcomes. Many requests required calculating the number of possible outcomes in scenarios like dice rolls, lottery games, dice sums, or forming committees, with some users providing hints or asking for corrections to previous attempts.
